Payroll Month-End Checklist

User manual · English · 13 steps
Learn the checks to complete at the end of each payroll month: work entries, batches and their status, payslips waiting to be paid, and the payroll report.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Work Entries menu

Open the Work Entries menu.

3. Work Entries

Click Work Entries.

4. Review the entries

Check there are no conflicts, then click the search bar to continue.

5. Payslips menu

Open the Payslips menu.

6. Batches

Click Batches.

7. Batch status

Look at the Status column, then click it to continue.

8. Payslips menu again

Open the Payslips menu again.

9. To Pay

Click To Pay.

10. Review the list

Check the list, then click the search bar to continue.

11. Reporting menu

Open the Reporting menu.

12. Payroll report

Click Payroll.

13. Check the figures

Review the totals, then click the search bar to finish.
